# =============================================================================
# Pinned DIRECT dependencies for the Anyscale training image (qwen3-omnispeak-d).
# =============================================================================
# Source-of-truth for the Python dependencies the project directly imports.
# Mirrored byte-for-byte into the image at /tmp/requirements.txt by the
# Dockerfile (heredoc), then installed via `pip install --pre -r ...`.
#
# IMPORTANT — when editing this file, edit the heredoc in anyscale/Dockerfile
# in lockstep. The shipped file must match this file exactly, otherwise
# the source-of-truth claim is void.
#
# Anchor stack (verified working on a real qwen3-omnispeak training host):
#   torch        == 2.11.0     (cu13 wheel — pip will resolve nvidia-*-cu13)
#   torchaudio   == 2.11.0
#   torchvision  == 0.26.0
#   transformers == 4.57.3
#   ms-swift     == 4.3.0.dev0 (--pre required)
#   deepspeed    == 0.18.9
#   ray          == 2.55.1
#   megatron-core== 0.17.0     (no longer requires transformer_engine)
#   mcore-bridge == 1.4.1
#
# Why torch 2.11 + cu13 (and NOT torch 2.5.1 + cu126 like earlier versions
# of this image): ms-swift 4.2.0+ unconditionally imports
#   from torch.distributed.fsdp import FSDPModule
# at swift.callbacks.activation_cpu_offload module load time. FSDPModule is
# a torch 2.6+ symbol (FSDP2). Pinning torch to 2.5.1 blew up `swift sft`
# at import. Upgrading to torch 2.11 + cu13 resolves it cleanly.
#
# Transitive deps (numpy, fastapi, NVIDIA cu13 runtime libs, triton, etc.)
# are NOT listed here — pip resolves them from the constraints below. If
# a transitive version drift causes a runtime issue, add the offender as
# a direct pin here, not the entire transitive closure.
# =============================================================================

# ---- Torch (anchor) ----
torch==2.11.0
torchaudio==2.11.0
torchvision==0.26.0

# ---- CUDA toolchain (nvcc) ----
# Required because deepspeed/ops/op_builder/builder.py:53 calls
#   subprocess.check_output([cuda_home + "/bin/nvcc", "-V"])
# at import time (deepspeed/__init__.py → ops/__init__.py →
# git_version_info.py → builder.is_compatible() → installed_cuda_version()).
# Anyscale's Ray base image carries no system /usr/local/cuda, so nvcc must
# come from the pip-installed wheel. The Dockerfile symlinks /usr/local/cuda
# → site-packages/nvidia/cuda_nvcc/ in Layer 4b.
nvidia-cuda-nvcc==13.0.88

# ---- CUDA toolchain — internal-minor version alignment (CRITICAL) ----
# nvcc/ptxas (from nvidia-cuda-nvcc==13.0.88, PTX ISA 9.0) and cicc/libdevice
# (from nvidia-nvvm) MUST be locked to the SAME minor version. If
# nvidia-nvvm is left unpinned, pip resolves it to whatever is latest
# (13.3.33 as of 2026-06-05 — emits PTX ISA 9.3) while nvidia-cuda-nvcc
# stays at 13.0.88 — ptxas 13.0.88 then refuses 9.3 PTX with:
#   ptxas .../flash_*_compute_*.ptx, line 9; fatal: Unsupported .version
#       9.3; current version is '9.0'
# This is what blew up FA3 build #3 (bld_pid2wk4yezui6dff6bt94v15c4) on
# 2026-06-05 — every nvcc-driven .o failed at the cicc → ptxas hand-off.
#
# Pin nvidia-nvvm + nvidia-cuda-crt + nvidia-cuda-cccl to the same 13.0.88
# minor as nvidia-cuda-nvcc so cicc emits PTX 9.0, matching ptxas 9.0.
# torch 2.11.0+cu130 already pins the rest of the runtime side
# (cuda-toolkit==13.0.2 → nvidia-cuda-runtime/cupti/nvrtc all 13.0.x).
nvidia-nvvm==13.0.88
nvidia-cuda-crt==13.0.88

# ---- CUDA C++ Core Libraries (CCCL: cub + libcudacxx + thrust + nv/target) ----
# Required to compile FlashAttention 3 (Layer 5 in Dockerfile). Without it,
# `cd flash-attention/hopper; pip install .` fails on
#   - cub/cub.cuh: No such file
#   - cccl/cuda/std/utility: No such file
#   - nv/target: No such file
# pip installs the wheel into <site-packages>/nvidia/cu13/include/{cccl,nv}/...,
# the same `nvidia/cu13/` namespace that nvidia-cuda-nvcc populates. The
# Layer 4b symlink /usr/local/cuda → that dir then exposes
# /usr/local/cuda/include/cccl/ and /usr/local/cuda/include/nv/ to nvcc and
# c++. FA3's hopper/setup.py has a `bare_metal_version >= 13.0` branch that
# prepends /usr/local/cuda/include/cccl to CPLUS_INCLUDE_PATH so plain
# `<cub/cub.cuh>` includes resolve.
# Pinned to 13.0.x to match nvcc / nvvm / crt's 13.0 minor (their 13.0.88
# patch is the alignment target, but cccl is header-only — does NOT
# participate in PTX/cubin emission — so a 13.0.x patch drift is harmless.
# Concrete reason for not pinning to ==13.0.88: PyPI cadence for cccl
# differs from nvcc/nvvm/crt; only 13.0.50 and 13.0.85 exist on the 13.0
# track (next release jumps to 13.1.78). Build #4 (bld_g967258aax1vqzzitl2xkww7vk)
# failed at pip resolve when cccl was pinned to ==13.0.88.
nvidia-cuda-cccl>=13.0,<13.1

# ---- ms-swift (training framework) ----
# `4.3.0.dev0` is auto-generated by setuptools_scm when installing from
# main HEAD; it is NOT published to PyPI (latest PyPI release is 4.2.3
# as of 2026-06-03). Install directly from the GitHub main branch.
# Drift risk acknowledged — pin to a commit SHA later once we lock the
# training run.
ms-swift @ git+https://github.com/modelscope/ms-swift.git@main
transformers==4.57.3
deepspeed==0.18.9
ray==2.55.1
modelscope==1.37.1

# ---- Megatron path (variant 3) ----
megatron-core==0.17.0
mcore-bridge==1.4.1

# ---- Multimodal audio / video IO ----
soundfile==0.13.1
librosa==0.11.0
decord==0.6.0
qwen_omni_utils==0.0.9

# ---- Codec tokenizer (target_audio → discrete tokens) ----
qwen-tts==0.1.1

# ---- Dataset tooling ----
pandas==2.3.3
einops==0.8.2
huggingface_hub==0.36.2

# ---- Experiment logging ----
wandb==0.27.0
swanlab==0.7.19
tensorboard==2.20.0


# ---- FlashAttention 2 & 3 (NOT pip dependencies — built from source in image) ----
# FA2 and FA3 are compiled from the upstream flash-attention repo at image build
# time; see `anyscale/Dockerfile` Layers 5-6. They are NOT listed here because
# there are no PyPI wheels for FA2/FA3 on torch 2.11 + cu13.
# FA2 (Ampere/Hopper): A100 fallback + H100 compatibility, module: `flash_attn`.
# FA3 (Hopper-only): primary H100 training backend, module: `flash_attn_interface`
# (pkg metadata `flash_attn_3`). Transformers 4.57.3 dispatches via
# `attn_implementation="flash_attention_3"` on H100 or `"flash_attention_2"` on A100.
